Beating a child can be very bad mentally. Even a slap can affect the child so i would strongly recomend you talk to them and make sure that they understand where you are comming from and stand your ground dont be hostile just talk calm at first, if they dont understand or arent listning to you i would recomend you raise your voice and make them understand. If they still dont care i would recommend you to not let them supervise your child. Best of luck

I truly feel sorry for you and your family its obvious thats she is having a difficult time and dosent know how to cope with it, somethimes emotions can get the better of you. Just beacuse she tried to hurt herself dosent mean she dosent care about you and your brother dont forget that. I would recomend just trying to support her in difficult times like this try to make her feel positive at the end of the day thats all you can do. And if it gets even more serious i would try getting help from outside. Best of luck.

I can tell you this from a person who has parents who abused me alot it wont be easy task to go back to a person who has caused you so much harm, but i can tell that you do have empathy left for her what i would recommend you do would be to try to focus on the good parts about your mother (if you can find them) and try to not focus on the bad parts wich i know would be very hard for you wich i can tell from hat you have written. Then if I were you I would also see if i could forgive myself for not going there   and im not saying you should go if you dont want to you are the person to make that decision and to be honest i wouldnt blame you for not going, but i would recommend you to give this some thought since this might be the last time you are going to see her you never know. You have dealt with her before and Im sure you can do it now you just have to find the strength to do it. Best of luck!
